blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: % — Zero or more characters in LIKE.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: INSERT adds a row; DELETE removes records matching a WHERE predicate. Omitting WHERE can delete every row.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: DROP TABLE removes the table itself, not just one record. It is a destructive schema operation.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: LIKE uses % for any number of characters and _ for a single character in standard SQL. SELECT * means all columns, a different use of *.
